dex.text: Stands in the green chasm at dusk holding its own head under one arm, and offers any passer-by a friendly game. Read the rules first. Then read them again.
dex.fact: Lud's Church in the Staffordshire Moorlands is often said to be the Green Chapel of the 14th-century poem Sir Gawain and the Green Knight, whose giant green knight is beheaded and simply picks his head back up.
